video_title: Mitch Johnson on Spurs DOMINANT Performance Against the New Orleans Pelicans

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's aggressive offensive start against the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: I thought he started the game off aggressive and I thought he was trying to play with a lot of force
quotes.quote: I thought he started the game off aggressive and I thought he was trying to play with a lot of force offensively specifically just in terms of taking up real estate, trying to get to the rim. It's cliché, and then it's, 'Why doesn't he do it every game?' But it's so interesting when people play like that, especially with his talent, and then it helps your rhythm with your shots and everything else. But I thought he did a really good job of playing with force.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama's aggressive start against the Pelicans: I thought he started the game off aggressive and I thought he was trying to play with a lot of force offensively specifically just in terms of taking up real estate

structured.context: Mitch Johnson discusses Victor Wembanyama's aggressive offensive performance against the New Orleans Pelicans.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Improving team passing quality and reducing turnovers
quotes.excerpt: I thought our quality of passing has been better though. And so, that's maybe a frustration
quotes.quote: Where I thought we got away from it a little bit, the turnovers, the last couple games have been creeping up a little too much. I thought our quality of passing has been better though. And so, that's maybe a frustration that a coach has to just take a step back and understand that there's going to be a little bit of a growth there. But 30 assists were good. I thought there were a few shots tonight that I felt like the shots had a really good chance of going in, and that was because of the pass previous to the shot attempt, and I think that's a really good feeling for a team.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson says the Spurs need to clean up their turnovers: The turnovers the last couple games have been creeping up a little too much. I thought our quality of passing has been better though

structured.context: Mitch Johnson reflects on the team's recent turnover issues and the quality of passing during the game.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of team chemistry and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: It's amazing in the sport when you play like that how much the ball finds you back.
quotes.quote: There was a play in the first quarter, maybe it was the second quarter early on, but Victor gets the rebound and he had it rolling, so I understand, but Keldon was in front of him and he didn't make a kick ahead, and that's just an absolute for us. And Keldon was open and we had the numbers, I believe it was a four-on-two, maybe even a four-on-one. And he shot a three, and I get it, he was rolling, but Keldon has to have the ball in that moment. And he had the ball in the second half or second quarter, he had the ball, kicked it ahead to Devin, Devin kicked it ahead to Keldon, and we got a shot at the rim. That stuff's contagious, that stuff, it's amazing in the sport when you play like that how much the ball finds you back. I thought Victor was the benefit of that, I thought Steph Castle was the benefit of that, I thought Carter was the benefit of that.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on team chemistry: There was a play where Victor had it rolling and shot a three but Keldon was open. That stuff is contagious. It is amazing in the sport when you play like that how much the ball finds you back

structured.context: Mitch Johnson emphasizes the importance of team chemistry and ball movement by highlighting specific plays involving multiple players.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle's impact as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I thought he did a great job just running the show.
quotes.quote: I thought he did a great job just running the show. Victor had it going, I thought he made a very conscious effort to get him the ball in a variety of ways. He did a good job of kicking the ball ahead early. I thought we got Julian and Devin really good shots too. I'll take those 16 shot attempts every single day of the week and bet they'll make more than five moving forward more nights than not. And he looked like he tweaked his foot or ankle, I mean he's fine, but so I think he did a good job of just doing what we needed and putting his energy in the right stuff.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson praises Stephon Castle for his playmaking: I thought he did a great job just running the show. Victor had it going and I thought he made a very conscious effort to get him the ball in a variety of ways

structured.context: Mitch Johnson evaluates Stephon Castle's playmaking performance and mentions he appeared to tweak his foot or ankle during the game.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive transition and shot selection issues
quotes.excerpt: The worst minutes of the non-Victor minutes has nothing to do with Luke in my opinion.
quotes.quote: I thought we had some moments where we did a really good job defensively in terms of shrinking the floor and showing crowds and gang rebounding. And I think, you know, the one area that group has to understand is to play complementary basketball on the offensive end to help the defense. That group, probably the worst minutes of the non-Victor minutes has nothing to do with Luke in my opinion. It's when we take quick shots and then we get where we're in transition defense a lot and we're on our heels. It's a little bit of a general statement, but I think if we could shore that up, I think that would help our offense and our defense more than anything else in those stretches.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on Spurs transition defense: The worst minutes of the non Victor minutes is when we take quick shots and then we get where we are in transition defense a lot and we are on our heels

structured.context: Mitch Johnson explains how poor offensive shot selection negatively impacts the team's defensive transition.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Decision to pull Victor Wembanyama after reaching 50 points
quotes.excerpt: I was just hoping he got to 50 when he did. That would have been hard to take him out
quotes.quote: I was just hoping he got to 50 when he did. That would have been hard to take him out that close to 50.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on pulling Victor Wembanyama after his 50 point game: I was just hoping he got to 50 when he did. That would have been hard to take him out that close to 50
